blocks.text: **myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves** — o'zbekcha «o'zim, o'zing, o'zi, o'zimiz, o'zingiz, o'zlari». Shakllari, enjoy yourself kabi iboralar, by myself va each other bilan asosiy farq qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 63-dars). Bu darsda — nozik joylar: qaysi predloglardan keyin -self kerak va qaysilaridan keyin kerak emas; o'zbekchada «o'zini» deyilsa ham, inglizchada -self siz aytiladigan fe'llar; **-selves** va **each other** farqi, **each other's**; va «aynan o'zi» degan urg'u ma'nosi (**the director herself**).

Harakat bajaruvchining o'ziga qaytsa, to'ldiruvchi o'rnida -self keladi: I cut **myself**, She blamed **herself**, They taught **themselves** Spanish. Bu qoida predlogdan keyin ham amal qiladi: Be proud **of yourself**, He's always talking **about himself**, Look after **yourselves**, She bought a present **for herself**. Taqqoslang: Aziz talked about **him** — boshqa bir yigit haqida gapirdi; Aziz talked about **himself** — o'zi haqida gapirdi. O'zbekchadagi «uni» va «o'zini» farqi aynan shu.

items.text: Be careful with that knife — you'll cut **yourself**.
items.translation: Pichoq bilan ehtiyot bo'l — **o'zingni** kesib olasan.

items.text: Bekzod taught **himself** to play the guitar by watching videos.
items.translation: Bekzod videolar ko'rib gitara chalishni **o'zi o'rgandi**.

items.text: She never talks about **herself**, so we know very little about her.
items.translation: U hech qachon **o'zi haqida** gapirmaydi, shuning uchun u haqda juda kam bilamiz.

blocks.text: Joy va yo'nalishni bildiruvchi predloglardan keyin (behind, next to, in front of, near, around, with — «yonida» ma'nosida, on — «yonida bor» ma'nosida) odatda **oddiy olmosh** ishlatiladi: bu yerda harakat o'ziga qaratilmagan, faqat joy ko'rsatilgan. She closed the door behind **her** («herself» emas); He put his bag next to **him**; Have you got any money **on you**?; I looked around **me**. Taqqoslang: She looked at **herself** in the mirror — bu yerda u o'ziga qaraydi, ya'ni harakat o'ziga qaytadi.

rows: She looked at **herself** in the mirror.
He put the bag next to **him**.
Have you got your passport with **you**?

blocks.text: O'zbekchadagi ko'p o'zlik fe'llari inglizchada **-self siz** aytiladi: **feel** (I feel tired — o'zimni charchagan his qilyapman), **relax** (tinchlanmoq), **concentrate** (diqqatini jamlamoq), **wash**, **shave**, **get dressed** (kiyinmoq), **get changed** (kiyim almashtirmoq), **meet** (uchrashmoq, tanishmoq), **worry** (xavotirlanmoq). -self bu fe'llar bilan faqat alohida urg'u kerak bo'lganda keladi, odatda bola yoki bemor haqida: The baby is learning to dress **himself** — chaqaloq o'zi kiyinishni o'rganyapti.

items.text: I don't **feel** very well — I think I'll stay at home.
Turn the music off, please — I can't **concentrate**.
We **met** outside the cinema at seven.

blocks.text: **-selves** — har biri o'zini: They blamed **themselves**. **each other** (rasmiyroq — **one another**) — biri ikkinchisini, ya'ni «bir-birini»: They blamed **each other**. Egalik shakli — **each other's**: They borrow **each other's** clothes (bir-birining kiyimini). O'zbekcha «bir-birini», «bir-biriga», «bir-birining», «bir-biri bilan» — bularning hammasi each other. meet, kiss, marry kabi fe'llarda ma'no o'zi aniq, shuning uchun each other ko'pincha tushib qoladi: They **met** in 2015.

items.text: Aziz and Madina have known **each other** since school.
items.translation: Aziz va Madina maktabdan beri **bir-birini** taniydi.

items.text: The twins often wear **each other's** clothes.
After the match the players were angry with **themselves**, not with the referee.
items.translation: O'yindan keyin futbolchilarning hakamdan emas, **o'zlaridan** jahli chiqdi.

blocks.text: Urg'u: the director herself, the film itself

-self «aynan o'zi, boshqa birov emas» degan urg'u ham beradi. U ikki o'rinda keladi: ot yoki olmoshdan keyin — I spoke to **the director herself** (direktorning o'zi bilan), **The film itself** was boring, but the music was great; yoki gap oxirida — I fixed the tap **myself** (o'zim, usta chaqirmasdan), Did you make this cake **yourself**? Bu ma'noda -self ni olib tashlasangiz ham gap to'g'ri qoladi, faqat urg'u yo'qoladi. **by myself** («yolg'iz», «hech kimning yordamisiz») va **on my own** — keyingi darsda (→ 83-dars).

items.text: I didn't book the trip through an agency — I organised it **myself**.
items.translation: Sayohatni agentlik orqali band qilmadim — hammasini **o'zim** tashkil qildim.

items.text: **The hotel itself** was lovely, but the area around it was very noisy.
items.translation: **Mehmonxonaning o'zi** ajoyib edi, lekin atrofi juda shovqinli edi.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I feel myself tired» → **I feel tired**; «Relax yourself» → **Relax**; «I can't concentrate myself» → **I can't concentrate**; «She closed the door behind herself» → **behind her**; «They love themselves» (bir-birini nazarda tutib) → **They love each other**; «each others' clothes» → **each other's clothes**; mehmonga «Help you!» → **Help yourself!**; «hisself», «theirselves» → **himself**, **themselves**; «Take your passport with yourself» → **with you**.

Tekshirish: harakat haqiqatan egaga qaytyaptimi? Ha bo'lsa — -self. «Bir-birini» bo'lsa — each other. Faqat joy ko'rsatilsa (orqasida, yonida, o'zi bilan) — oddiy olmosh. O'zbekchada «o'zimni his qilyapman», «o'zimni bosdim» desak ham, inglizchada **feel**, **calm down** — -self siz.

rows: **The film itself** was boring. I did it **myself**.

examples.title: The same person: **blame yourself**, **burn herself**
examples.description: Harakat bajaruvchining o'ziga qaytsa — -self: cut yourself, blame herself, teach himself, introduce ourselves.

sentences.text: Don't blame **yourself** — the accident wasn't your fault.
sentences.translation: **O'zingni** ayblama — avariya sening aybing bilan bo'lmadi.

sentences.text: Kate burnt **herself** on the oven while she was taking out the bread.
sentences.translation: Keyt nonni olayotganda pechga tegib **o'zini** kuydirib oldi.

sentences.text: Jasur taught **himself** Korean in two years and now works as a translator.
sentences.translation: Jasur ikki yilda koreys tilini **o'zi o'rgandi**, hozir tarjimon bo'lib ishlaydi.

sentences.text: We introduced **ourselves** to the new neighbours and invited them for tea.
sentences.translation: Yangi qo'shnilarga **o'zimizni tanishtirdik** va ularni choyga taklif qildik.

sentences.text: The kids are old enough to look after **themselves** for an hour.
sentences.translation: Bolalar bir soat **o'zlariga** qaray oladigan yoshda.

sentences.text: Are you sure you can carry that heavy box? Don't hurt **yourself**!
sentences.translation: O'sha og'ir qutini ko'tara olishingizga ishonchingiz komilmi? **O'zingizni** shikastlab qo'ymang!

sentences.text: Our cat washes **itself** for ages after every meal.
sentences.translation: Mushugimiz har ovqatdan keyin uzoq vaqt **o'zini** yalab tozalaydi.

sentences.text: Madina looked at **herself** in the mirror and smiled nervously.
sentences.translation: Madina ko'zguda **o'ziga** qaradi va hayajon bilan jilmaydi.

sentences.text: If you two want to win, you'll have to push **yourselves** much harder.
sentences.translation: Ikkalangiz g'olib bo'lmoqchi bo'lsangiz, **o'zingizdan** ancha ko'proq talab qilishingiz kerak.

sentences.text: Oliver cut **himself** shaving this morning, so he's got a plaster on his chin.
sentences.translation: Oliver bugun ertalab soqol olayotib **o'zini** kesib oldi, shuning uchun iyagida plastir bor.

examples.title: Prepositions: **proud of yourself** — but **behind her**
examples.description: Predlogdan keyin ham, harakat o'ziga qaytsa — -self: proud of yourself, talk about himself. Faqat joy ko'rsatilsa (behind, next to, around, with, on) — oddiy olmosh.

sentences.text: You passed all your exams — you should be proud **of yourself**!
sentences.translation: Barcha imtihonlardan o'tding — **o'zing bilan** faxrlanishing kerak!

sentences.text: James is so boring: he only ever talks **about himself**.
sentences.translation: Jeyms juda zerikarli: u faqat **o'zi haqida** gapiradi.

sentences.text: Nilufar bought a new watch **for herself** with her first salary.
sentences.translation: Nilufar birinchi maoshiga **o'ziga** yangi soat sotib oldi.

sentences.text: When she left the room, she closed the door quietly **behind her**.
sentences.translation: Xonadan chiqqach, u eshikni **orqasidan** sekin yopdi.

sentences.text: Aziz put his bag on the seat **next to him** so that nobody would sit there.
sentences.translation: Hech kim o'tirmasin deb, Aziz sumkasini **yonidagi** o'rindiqqa qo'ydi.

sentences.text: Have you got any cash **on you**? The taxi driver doesn't take cards.
sentences.translation: **Yoningizda** naqd pul bormi? Taksi haydovchisi karta qabul qilmaydi.

sentences.text: I'm really angry **with myself** for missing such an easy goal.
sentences.translation: Shunday oson golni o'tkazib yuborganim uchun **o'zimdan** juda jahlim chiqyapti.

sentences.text: Sarah looked around **her**, but she couldn't see her friends anywhere.
sentences.translation: Sara **atrofiga** qaradi, lekin do'stlarini hech qayerda ko'rmadi.

sentences.text: Please take your passports **with you** when you leave the hotel.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonadan chiqayotganda pasportlaringizni **o'zingiz bilan** oling, iltimos.

sentences.text: Bekzod is very pleased **with himself** because he fixed the car without any help.
sentences.translation: Bekzod mashinani hech kimning yordamisiz tuzatgani uchun **o'zidan** juda mamnun.

examples.title: No **-self**: **feel**, **relax**, **concentrate**
examples.description: O'zbekchada o'zlik shaklida, inglizchada -self siz: feel, relax, concentrate, get dressed, get changed, meet, worry, shave. -self faqat alohida urg'u uchun.

sentences.text: I **feel** much better after a good night's sleep.
sentences.translation: Yaxshilab uxlab olganimdan keyin **o'zimni** ancha yaxshi **his qilyapman**.

sentences.text: Sit down, **relax**, and tell me exactly what happened.
sentences.translation: O'tiring, **tinchlaning** va nima bo'lganini aniq aytib bering.

sentences.text: With all this noise from the building site, I can't **concentrate** on my work.
sentences.translation: Qurilishdan kelayotgan bu shovqin tufayli ishimga **diqqatimni jamlay olmayapman**.

sentences.text: Tom **got dressed** quickly and ran to the bus stop.
sentences.translation: Tom tezda **kiyindi** va avtobus bekatiga yugurdi.

sentences.text: Give me five minutes — I need to **get changed** before the party.
sentences.translation: Besh daqiqa bering — ziyofatdan oldin **kiyimimni almashtirishim** kerak.

sentences.text: Dilnoza and her husband **met** at university, in the same economics class.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza va eri universitetda, bitta iqtisod guruhida **tanishishgan**.

sentences.text: Don't **worry** — the doctor says it's nothing serious.
sentences.translation: **Xavotir olmang** — shifokorning aytishicha, jiddiy narsa emas.

sentences.text: Grandpa still **shaves** with an old-fashioned razor every morning.
sentences.translation: Bobom hali ham har tong eski uslubdagi ustara bilan **soqol oladi**.

sentences.text: How do you **feel** about moving to another city? — Excited, but a bit nervous.
sentences.translation: Boshqa shaharga ko'chishni qanday **his qilyapsiz**? — Hayajondaman, lekin biroz xavotirdaman.

sentences.text: My little brother is only four, but he can already **dress himself**.
sentences.translation: Ukam bor-yo'g'i to'rt yoshda, lekin allaqachon **o'zi kiyina oladi**.

examples.title: **themselves** or **each other**?
examples.description: -selves — har biri o'zini; each other — bir-birini. Egalik — **each other's** (bir-birining).

sentences.text: Emma and Oliver have been sending **each other** messages all day.
sentences.translation: Emma va Oliver kun bo'yi **bir-biriga** xabar yuborishyapti.

sentences.text: The two candidates blamed **each other** for the failure of the project.
sentences.translation: Ikki nomzod loyiha muvaffaqiyatsizligi uchun **bir-birini** aybladi.

sentences.text: The students prepared **themselves** for the exam by doing past papers.
sentences.translation: Talabalar o'tgan yillardagi testlarni yechib, imtihonga **o'zlarini** tayyorlashdi.

sentences.text: We don't see **each other** very often since Aziz moved to London.
sentences.translation: Aziz Londonga ko'chib ketganidan beri **bir-birimizni** tez-tez ko'rmaymiz.

sentences.text: Bekzod and his brother always borrow **each other's** clothes without asking.
sentences.translation: Bekzod va akasi doim so'ramasdan **bir-birining** kiyimini olib kiyishadi.

sentences.text: After the argument, the two sisters didn't speak to **each other** for a month.
sentences.translation: Janjaldan keyin ikki opa-singil bir oy **bir-biri** bilan gaplashmadi.

sentences.text: Did you and Kate enjoy **yourselves** at the festival?
sentences.translation: Siz va Keyt festivalda **maza qildingizmi**?

sentences.text: Good teams trust **each other**, while weak teams only think about **themselves**.
sentences.translation: Kuchli jamoalarda a'zolar **bir-biriga** ishonadi, kuchsiz jamoalar esa faqat **o'zlarini** o'ylaydi.

sentences.text: How long have you two known **each other**? — Since we were five!
sentences.translation: Ikkalangiz **bir-biringizni** qachondan beri taniysiz? — Besh yoshligimizdan beri!

sentences.text: Instead of helping **each other**, the neighbours spent years complaining about **one another**.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilar **bir-biriga** yordam berish o'rniga yillar davomida **bir-biridan** shikoyat qilishdi.

examples.title: Emphasis: **the director herself**, **the flat itself**
examples.description: -self «aynan o'zi, boshqa birov emas» urg'usi: ot yoki olmoshdan keyin yoki gap oxirida. Olib tashlansa ham gap to'g'ri qoladi.

sentences.text: I didn't speak to her secretary — I spoke to **the director herself**.
sentences.translation: Kotibasi bilan emas, **direktorning o'zi** bilan gaplashdim.

sentences.text: **The flat itself** is quite small, but the view from the balcony is amazing.
sentences.translation: **Kvartiraning o'zi** ancha kichik, lekin balkondan ko'rinish ajoyib.

sentences.text: Did you really make this wedding cake **yourself**? It looks professional!
sentences.translation: Bu to'y tortini rostdan ham **o'zingiz** pishirdingizmi? Professional ko'rinyapti!

sentences.text: We didn't call a plumber — Dad repaired the pipe **himself**.
sentences.translation: Santexnik chaqirmadik — trubani dadam **o'zi** tuzatdi.

sentences.text: **The minister herself** visited the school to hear the teachers' complaints.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchilarning shikoyatlarini eshitish uchun **vazirning o'zi** maktabga keldi.

sentences.text: Madina **herself** admits that she spends too much time on her phone.
sentences.translation: Telefonda juda ko'p vaqt o'tkazishini **Madinaning o'zi** ham tan oladi.

sentences.text: **The journey itself** took only two hours, but we waited at the border for five.
sentences.translation: **Yo'lning o'zi** bor-yo'g'i ikki soat davom etdi, lekin chegarada besh soat kutdik.

sentences.text: If you don't believe me, go and see it **for yourself**.
sentences.translation: Ishonmasangiz, borib **o'zingiz** ko'ring.

sentences.text: Why don't you ask the author **himself**? He's signing books at the shop today.
sentences.translation: Nega **muallifning o'zidan** so'ramaysiz? U bugun do'konda kitoblariga dastxat qo'yyapti.

sentences.text: I **myself** have never been to Khiva, but my parents say it's like a museum.
sentences.translation: **Men o'zim** Xivada hech qachon bo'lmaganman, lekin ota-onam u ochiq osmon ostidagi muzeyga o'xshaydi deyishadi.

examples.title: Set phrases: **help yourself**, **make yourself at home**
examples.description: Tayyor iboralar: help yourself, make yourself at home, behave yourself, express yourself, pull yourself together, keep it to yourself.

sentences.text: Come in and **make yourselves at home** — dinner will be ready in ten minutes.
sentences.translation: Kiringlar, **o'z uyingizdek bo'linglar** — kechki ovqat o'n daqiqada tayyor bo'ladi.

sentences.text: There's plenty of plov, so please **help yourself** to more.
sentences.translation: Palov ko'p, iltimos, **tortinmasdan** yana **oling**.

sentences.text: **Behave yourselves** while I'm out, or there'll be no ice cream.
sentences.translation: Men yo'qligimda **o'zingizni yaxshi tutinglar**, bo'lmasa muzqaymoq yo'q.

sentences.text: Some children find it hard to **express themselves** in a foreign language.
sentences.translation: Ba'zi bolalar chet tilida **fikrini ifoda etishga** qiynaladi.

sentences.text: I know you're upset, but **pull yourself together** — the interview starts in five minutes.
sentences.translation: Bilaman, xafasan, lekin **o'zingni qo'lga ol** — suhbat besh daqiqadan keyin boshlanadi.

sentences.text: This is a secret, so please **keep it to yourself**.
sentences.translation: Bu sir, iltimos, **hech kimga aytma**.

sentences.text: Did everyone **enjoy themselves** at the graduation party?
sentences.translation: Bitiruv kechasida hamma **maza qildimi**?

sentences.text: Sarah has really **made a name for herself** as a journalist.
sentences.translation: Sara jurnalist sifatida chinakam **nom chiqardi**.

sentences.text: **Take care of yourself**, and call us as soon as you land in London.
sentences.translation: **O'zingga ehtiyot bo'l**, Londonga qo'nishing bilan bizga qo'ng'iroq qil.

sentences.text: Jasur couldn't **bring himself** to tell his parents that he'd failed the exam.
sentences.translation: Jasur imtihondan yiqilganini ota-onasiga aytishga **o'zida jur'at topa olmadi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: the first day in a shared flat
examples.description: Ikki yigit umumiy kvartirada tanishadi: -self, each other, tayyor iboralar va -self siz fe'llar (get changed, relax).

sentences.text: — Hi, I'm Aziz. You must be Oliver — come in and **make yourself at home**.
sentences.translation: — Salom, men Azizman. Siz Oliver bo'lsangiz kerak — kiring, **o'z uyingizdek bo'ling**.

sentences.text: — Thanks! Do you and Jasur know **each other** from university?
sentences.translation: — Rahmat! Siz Jasur bilan **bir-biringizni** universitetdan taniysizmi?

sentences.text: — Yes, we've shared this flat for two years and never argued with **each other**.
sentences.translation: — Ha, bu kvartirada ikki yildan beri birga yashaymiz va hech qachon **bir-birimiz** bilan janjallashmaganmiz.

sentences.text: — Great. I should warn you that I'm not very good at looking after **myself**.
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. Oldindan aytib qo'yay, **o'zimga** qarashni unchalik eplay olmayman.

sentences.text: — Don't worry, Jasur cooks, and we just **help ourselves** to whatever's in the fridge.
sentences.translation: — Xavotir olmang, Jasur ovqat qiladi, biz esa muzlatgichda nima bo'lsa, **tortinmay olaveramiz**.

sentences.text: — Sounds perfect. Did you two paint this room **yourselves**?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r ekan. Bu xonani ikkalangiz **o'zingiz** bo'yadingizmi?

sentences.text: — We did, and we nearly killed **each other** choosing the colour!
sentences.translation: — Ha, rang tanlayotganda **bir-birimizni** o'ldirib qo'yishimizga sal qoldi!

sentences.text: — Ha! I'll put my things in here and **get changed**, if that's OK.
sentences.translation: — Ha-ha! Narsalarimni shu yerga qo'yib, **kiyimimni almashtiraman**, mayli bo'lsa.

sentences.text: — Of course. Then come to the kitchen and **relax** — the kettle's on.
sentences.translation: — Albatta. Keyin oshxonaga kelib **dam oling** — choynak qaynayapti.

sentences.text: — Thanks, Aziz. I can already tell I'm going to **enjoy myself** here.
sentences.translation: — Rahmat, Aziz. Bu yerda **vaqtim yaxshi o'tishini** hozirdanoq sezib turibman.

examples.title: Mixed: work, health and relationships
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: -self, oddiy olmosh, -self siz fe'llar, each other va urg'u — murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: The new manager introduced **herself** and then asked us to introduce **ourselves**.
sentences.translation: Yangi menejer **o'zini tanishtirdi**, keyin bizdan ham **o'zimizni tanishtirishimizni** so'radi.

sentences.text: If you **feel** dizzy, sit down and don't try to drive **yourself** home.
sentences.translation: Boshingiz aylansa, o'tiring va uyga **o'zingiz** mashina haydab ketishga urinmang.

sentences.text: Doctors say we should listen to our bodies and not push **ourselves** too hard.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlarning aytishicha, tanamizga quloq solishimiz va **o'zimizni** haddan tashqari zo'riqtirmasligimiz kerak.

sentences.text: After twenty years of marriage, they still make **each other** laugh every day.
sentences.translation: Yigirma yillik turmushdan keyin ham ular har kuni **bir-birini** kuldirishadi.

sentences.text: **The software itself** is free, but you have to pay for the training.
sentences.translation: **Dasturning o'zi** bepul, lekin o'qitish uchun pul to'lash kerak.

sentences.text: Kate sat down at the desk, put her coffee **next to her** and started typing.
sentences.translation: Keyt stolga o'tirdi, qahvasini **yoniga** qo'ydi va yozishni boshladi.

sentences.text: Why are you talking to **yourself**? — I'm practising my presentation!
sentences.translation: Nega **o'zing bilan o'zing** gaplashyapsan? — Taqdimotimni mashq qilyapman!

sentences.text: My grandparents built this house **themselves**, brick by brick, in the 1970s.
sentences.translation: Bobom va buvim bu uyni 1970-yillarda g'ishtma-g'isht **o'zlari** qurishgan.

sentences.text: We were so tired that we couldn't **concentrate** on anything after lunch.
sentences.translation: Shunchalik charchagan edikki, tushlikdan keyin hech narsaga **diqqatimizni jamlay olmadik**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza and Bekzod blamed **each other** for the mistake, but in fact both of them should have blamed **themselves**.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza va Bekzod xato uchun **bir-birini** ayblashdi, aslida esa ikkalasi ham **o'zini** ayblashi kerak edi.
